overclaims: The accessible primary study supplies earlier evidence of left-leaning model responses, including Grok 3 variants, but it does not establish their overall distance from Musk during June 2025.

The rationale says the Grok 3 variants were perceived as left-leaning. The quoted text names no Grok results, and the study exempts one model without saying which, so the evidence doesn't show this.
